I can’t give an exact value from that blurry chart. If the axis labels or data values aren’t readable, there’s no reliable way to determine an exact number from the image alone — I must avoid fabricating precise figures.

Options I can do next (pick one):
- You upload a higher-resolution or original source (spreadsheet, slide, CSV, PDF page) and I’ll read the exact value.
- I can attempt an approximate estimate from the image (give a value plus a stated uncertainty and how it was estimated). This is not exact and may be off.
- I can walk you through extracting the data yourself (open the original file, view chart data in the authoring app, enable data labels, or run OCR/enhancement).

Which would you like? If you want an estimate now, upload the blurry image (or tell me you want me to proceed) and I’ll provide an approximate value with a confidence range and a short note on the method.
